These compounds, in turn, are linked to Tankyrase-2, indicating a possible pathway through which Ergocryptine may influence Tankyrase-2 activity. The scores from the two paths, while not perfectly aligned, suggest a consistent pattern of interaction, though the exact mechanism remains unclear. The evidence supports a potential role for Ergocryptine in modulating Tankyrase-2 through its interaction with downstream targets, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm this relationship.
